items.text: Seahawks placing first-round RB Jadarian Price on IR due to chest injury aggravated at practice; misses minimum four weeks. Signed Velus Jones Jr. off PS.
Colts WR Keenan Allen (groin) downgraded to OUT vs Commanders.
items.why: Groin; Schefter corroborates + elevation of Westbrook-Ikhine

items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Week 4 after hip injury; expected to play vs PHI.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury list; McVay expects play
items.implication: WR1/2 ceiling if full snaps; monitor limits
items.opportunity: routes/targets as WR1; possible snap limit

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN for Week 4 after hamstring; good to go vs DAL.
Devonta Smith, Dallas Goedert OUT (plus Baun); Eagles missing key pieces vs Rams.
items.why: ETR list; Schefter confirmation on Smith

items.text: Great to have Puka Nacua (hip) back but speculation he could have snaps limited; we'll see. Projections updated.
items.implication: Start but have backup ready; Adams share risk if limited
items.conflict: full IN listing vs limit speculation

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) return. DvP: Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring 7.3% (most in NFL). Texans implied 7th-most points.
items.opportunity: high target share in positive game script

items.text: The moment Jordan Addison truthers have been waiting for. Home vs borderline NFL secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.why: JJ out; home vs soft secondary

items.text: Eagles situation getting worse. Without three most important: DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun vs Rams.
items.implication: Fade Eagles pass catchers/Hurts volume risk; Wicks opportunity

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost GL/base to Emmanuel Wilson, pass work to Holani, back-to-back fumbles, chest hurt, Charbonnet back at practice. Passes eye test longer-term; far from over. Projections updated.
items.implication: Hold long-term but sit now; monitor Charbonnet
items.opportunity: prior GL/pass erosion already limited upside

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE (TNF): 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches; Dowdle out again. CLE allows 88+ yds to RB every game. Workhorse.
items.why: 90% snaps/near-full touches; Dowdle out; soft CLE run D

items.text: LOVE Jeremiyah Love @ NYG: RB5 utilization, 26 touches (more than W1+W2 combined); double-digit target share every game. NYG allows 5.1 YPC (3rd-most).
items.why: Explosive utilization + soft NYG run D + receiving

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: RB27 utilization, 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snaps down to 42% (13% 3rd down). SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
items.why: Low usage/routes + tough SEA run D
